page.overview:
Who is Behedesh?

King Behedesh was a Tomb King from Zandri.

Behedesh was the inventor of the skull catapults and used them massively during the suppression of the Arabian rulers.

Around -236 IC to -241 IC he defeated in the Chariot Wars the Black Wolf Goblins and the Gap-Toothed Orcs. More than seven thousand chariots took part in the final battle in the Darklands.

He and King Memnesh fought against Tileans many times after the despoil of Zandri in 2506 IC, continously attacking while the invaders remained in the Land of the Dead.
